data.title: 克莱尔 · 庭院草坪的膝枕摸头小憩

data.promptProse: Under the shade of a lush garden tree on a sunny afternoon lawn, Claire Kagenou sits gracefully on the grass offering a gentle lap pillow, softly stroking hair with a tender blushing smile.
